name: Override: reset odometry on red's wall
description: Drives 5 in off red's wall, turns, drives 37 in between the neutral left Goal and the Cups on the wall, turns to face the wall and resets its odometry on it. After the two turns odometry is 1.2 in from the real robot. The wall reset pushes at 2 V with an 800 mA stall current, finds the wall in 0.6 s and leaves odometry within 0.1 in. At 2 V each motor draws 0.91 A on the wall, so the stall current comes down from its default of 1000 mA. The step's defaults, 3 V and 1000 mA, find this wall too, in 0.5 s, and push on it with 98 N in place of 59 N. From 4 V up this robot's wheels slip against the wall, its motors keep turning, and wallReset() never sees a stall. The wall gives y and the heading. It says nothing about x, so the step sets x to what odometry already had.

steps.note: far enough off the wall to turn twice without touching it
between the neutral left Goal and the Cups on the wall
2 V: 0.91 A a motor on the wall, so the stall current comes down to 800 mA
